beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Every episode so far has been building toward a garden and a hill. This is the night the plan got paid for. Stay close. This is what the council was about.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: After the last supper, Jesus led his friends across the valley to an olive grove called Gethsemane — the oil press. And there, the weight began to come down.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: My soul is exceeding sorrowful unto death: tarry ye here, and watch.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then he went a stone's throw further, and knelt. And every sin, every grief, every shame, every lonely midnight of every child of Adam began to press down onto one sinless soul.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Father, if thou be willing, remove this cup from me: nevertheless not my will, but thine, be done.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: There it is — the sentence from before the world, now costing everything. Thy will be done was easy to say in the council. In the garden, it bled.

beats.speaker: scripture
beats.text: And being in an agony he prayed more earnestly: and his sweat was as it were great drops of blood falling down to the ground.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Centuries later, the risen Lord described that night himself — the only firsthand account of an atonement ever given:

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: For behold, I, God, have suffered these things for all, that they might not suffer if they would repent.

beats.speaker: jesus
beats.text: Which suffering caused myself, even God, the greatest of all, to tremble because of pain, and to bleed at every pore, and to suffer both body and spirit.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Then betrayal, with a kiss. A rigged midnight trial. And Rome's worst. The devil threw everything at getting him to quit — or to call the twelve legions of angels he actually had.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He did not call them. Heaven held its armies parked behind the stars — because he asked it to. He was held to that cross by no nail. He was held there by the same will that spoke in the council. And when the debt was paid to the last breath:

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: Finished. Not I am finished — IT is finished. The debt. The ransom. The distance between you and home. Lucifer's plan would have saved your body by erasing your soul. The Father's plan saved the whole person — and this hill is where the bill was paid.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: But why couldn't God just forgive — wave it off, skip the cross? Because justice is real, and mercy cannot rob it. So mercy paid it. Forgiveness was never God waiving the debt. It was God eating it.

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.text: He was laid in a borrowed tomb before sundown, and a great stone sealed the door. And for about forty hours, the devil believed he had finally won. Remember that feeling of his. It is about to become the biggest miscalculation in history.

card.speaker: narrator
card.text: Thy will be done was easy in the council. In the garden it bled. He said it anyway — for you.
